name: Splintered Hilt
description:
A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.
The chips and grooves speak to the brutal battles its owner once weathered.
fullDescription: A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue. The chips and grooves speak to the brutal battles its owner once weathered.\nPerhaps their obsession with immortality led the one who made the golems to construct their heavy longswords of marble rather than metal. Today, this broken hilt stands testament to the utter falsity of that ideal.
